name: 模糊聚焦文字
title: 模糊聚焦文字
description: 文字像失焦的镜头一样逐词聚焦：每个片段从模糊、透明、偏移的入场状态弹出，沿错峰顺序依次收敛到清晰，五种内置效果（模糊 / 缩放 / 3D 翻转 / 纯聚焦 / 漂移）各有自己的模糊档位、弹簧过冲与退场姿态；支持入视口、加载、悬停、点击四种触发，可循环退场再聚焦，悬停单词还能让其余词虚化变暗。
cardDescription: 词句从失焦到对焦逐个弹出，错峰汇聚成清晰文字。
keywords: 词句从失焦到对焦逐个弹出

api.name: text
api.description: 要揭示的文字；按空格拆成片段

api.name: delay
api.description: 片段之间的错峰间隔（ms）；0 一起出现

api.name: className
api.description: 段落附加类名

api.name: animateBy
api.description: 拆分粒度：整词或单字

api.name: direction
api.description: 片段从哪个方向进场

api.name: threshold
api.description: view 触发的可见比例阈值

api.name: rootMargin
api.description: view 触发的根元素外边距

api.name: animationFrom
api.description: 自定义入场状态，替换内置 from 状态

api.name: animationTo
api.description: 自定义关键帧序列，替换内置状态

api.name: easing
api.description: 自定义关键帧的缓动；缺省线性

api.name: onAnimationComplete
api.description: 揭示落定时回调

api.name: stepDuration
api.description: 每步动画时长（秒）；总时长由此推出

api.name: blur
api.description: 起始模糊半径（px）；同时缩放各效果的模糊量

api.name: distance
api.description: 位移部分的行进距离（px）

api.name: effect
api.description: 五种内置效果：模糊、缩放、翻转、聚焦、漂移

api.name: staggerFrom
api.description: 错峰起点；random 按文本确定性洗牌

api.name: trigger
api.description: 启动方式；hover/click 在落定后交互重播

api.name: loop
api.description: 循环：模糊退场后再重新聚焦

api.name: loopDelay
api.description: 落定后到退场的间隔（秒）

api.name: color
api.description: 段落文字颜色

api.name: fromColor
api.description: 进出场时片段的着色，落定过渡回继承色

api.name: focusOnHover
api.description: 悬停某个词时其余词模糊变暗

prompt:
Implement the "BlurText" component from zero: text that arrives out of focus — every word (or character) starts blurred and transparent, then crisply resolves with a soft-focus reveal, piece by piece with a controllable stagger order. Five built-in effects (blur, zoom, tilt, focus, drift) each push pieces in from a different direction with their own blur profile, spring overshoot and exit state; an optional loop blurs the text back out and re-resolves it forever. Full specification follows; it must not depend on external pages, videos, images, font files, or off-the-shelf effect components. ## Structure & rendering - React >= 18 plus the motion package (`motion` components, `MotionConfig`, spring transitions); one file (BlurText.jsx), no CSS file — all styles inline. No iframe. - Root is a `

` with display flex, flex-wrap wrap, the `color` prop, and cursor pointer when trigger is "click"; pointerenter drives trigger "hover", click drives trigger "click". It is wrapped in `` so system reduced-motion preferences are honoured. A visually-hidden span carries the full plain text; every animated piece is aria-hidden. - Text splits on spaces into words; animateBy "words" makes each word one piece (padded with a non-breaking space except the last), "characters" splits every word into single-character pieces with non-breaking spaces between words. Words render as inline-flex wrappers so they wrap as units; pieces are inline-block with will-change: transform, filter, opacity. Changing `text` remounts the pieces and restarts the reveal. - Stagger ranks: "start" ranks pieces front-to-back, "end" back-to-front, "center" by distance from the middle (half ranks for even counts), "random" shuffles deterministically — an FNV-style seed hashed from the full text drives a linear-congruential generator and a Fisher–Yates shuffle, so the same text always shuffles the same way. Per-piece delay = rank × stagger where stagger = delay/1000 seconds. ## Effects - Five built-in effects, each parameterized by `blur` (px) and `distance` (px), oriented by `direction` (top/bottom/left/right map to a y/x axis and a sign): - blur (default): pieces start at blur(10px), opacity 0 and offset by +distance along the axis, resolving straight to sharp, opaque and in place; exit reverses to blurred, transparent and offset −0.6 × distance. - zoom: starts blurred 1.2×, scaled 1.4 and pushed 0.35 × distance inward; exits shrinking to 0.82 scale. Bounce 0.25. - tilt: pieces flip in from a 55° rotateX (vertical directions) or rotateY (horizontal) with 600px perspective, half the distance offset, straightening through a slight counter-lean; transform origin sits on the entering edge. Exit falls away at −40°. - focus: pure rack-focus — pieces start blurred 1.4× at opacity 0.32 and scale 1.12 with no movement, easing in-out throughout; no spring, longest settle. - drift: pieces slide in horizontally 1.6 × distance (direction right/left decides the sign) with a 28° skew that unwinds, vertical push only on vertical directions; exit drifts the opposite way with +20° skew. Bounce 0.3. - Each effect defines: a from-state, an end (rest) state, an exit state, the fade easing for opacity/filter (linear for blur, ease-out for zoom/drift/tilt, in-out for focus), a spring bounce factor (none for focus), a settle factor (how much of the run the movement spring eats), and an exit ease (ease-in except focus's in-out). - The in-animation interpolates each property from its from-state to its rest state over totalDuration = stepDuration × (number of steps − 1), i.e. 0.35s per step by default. Opacity/filter follow the fade ease; movement keys (x, y, scale, rotateX, rotateY, skewX) present in the from-state ride a spring with visualDuration = totalDuration × settle and the effect's bounce. Every piece delays by rank × stagger. Custom `animationFrom`/`animationTo`/`easing` replace the built-in states entirely: keyframes then walk the full user sequence with evenly spaced times and the user easing (default linear). - Exit animation: pieces animate to the exit state over stepDuration × 1.3 with the exit ease, staggering at 0.4 × the in-rate (reverse order emerges naturally from the ranks). - Phases: trigger "load" starts in immediately; "hover"/"click" start settled (initial=false on pieces) and replay through out → in on interaction; "view" starts hidden and flips to in when an IntersectionObserver (threshold, rootMargin) sees the paragraph, once. The replay only fires when settled, and never interrupts an exit. With loop on, the settled phase schedules out after loopDelay seconds and out chains back to in, forever; onAnimationComplete fires when the in-phase settles. ## Extras & accessibility - focusOnHover: hovering a word keeps it sharp while every other word blurs by clamp(blur × 0.3, 2–6px) and dims to opacity 0.3, both transitioning 0.45s with a soft cubic-bezier; leaving resets. Hover words track independently of the reveal state. - fromColor tints the pieces during entry and exit, with a CSS color transition timed to each piece's stagger (90% of totalDuration in, exitDuration out) so the colour settles to the inherited colour as pieces resolve. - prefers-reduced-motion is delegated to MotionConfig ("user"), so system preferences collapse the animation; the IntersectionObserver still gates visibility-triggered runs. ## Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |------|------|---------|-------------| | text | string | "" | The text to reveal; split on spaces into pieces. | | delay | number | 200 | Stagger between pieces, in ms; 0 plays all at once. | | className | string | "" | Extra class names for the paragraph. | | animateBy | "words" \| "characters" | "words" | Split granularity of the pieces. | | direction | "top" \| "bottom" \| "left" \| "right" | "top" | Where pieces travel in from. | | threshold | number | 0.1 | IntersectionObserver visibility ratio for the "view" trigger. | | rootMargin | string | "0px" | IntersectionObserver root margin for the "view" trigger. | | animationFrom | object | - | Custom entry state per piece; replaces the built-in from-state. | | animationTo | object[] | - | Custom keyframe steps; replaces the built-in states. | | easing | string \| number[] | - | Easing for the custom keyframe sequence; defaults to linear. | | onAnimationComplete | () => void | - | Called when the reveal settles. | | stepDuration | number | 0.35 | Seconds per animation step; drives the total duration. | | blur | number | 10 | Starting blur radius in px; also scales zoom/focus/drift blur. | | distance | number | 50 | Travel distance in px for the movement part of the effect. | | effect | "blur" \| "zoom" \| "tilt" \| "focus" \| "drift" | "blur" | Which built-in effect to run. | | staggerFrom | "start" \| "end" \| "center" \| "random" | "start" | Which piece animates first; random is deterministic per text. | | trigger | "view" \| "load" \| "hover" \| "click" | "view" | What starts the reveal; hover/click replay on interaction. | | loop | boolean | false | Blur out and re-resolve forever. | | loopDelay | number | 2 | Seconds to hold the settled text before looping out. | | color | string | - | Text colour for the paragraph. | | fromColor | string | - | Colour pieces tint during entry/exit, settling to the inherited colour. | | focusOnHover | boolean | false | Hovering a word blurs and dims the others. | ## Delivery & validation - Deliver the complete content of BlurText.jsx plus install steps and the usage example; no ellipses, no "fill in the core yourself" placeholders. - Validate: words resolve blurred-to-sharp with the configured stagger order (start/end/center/random all rank correctly and random is stable per text); all five effects land with their own blur/scale/tilt/skew profiles and spring overshoot; direction flips the travel axis and sign; custom animationFrom/animationTo/easing override the built-ins; view/load/hover/click triggers behave (hover and click replay only when settled); loop blurs out after loopDelay and re-resolves without getting stuck mid-exit; focusOnHover dims siblings independently; fromColor settles to the inherited colour; reduced motion collapses the animation; text changes restart cleanly; word wrapping keeps words intact at 375 / 768 / 1440 wide; screen readers get the plain text while pieces are aria-hidden.
